composition: Studio landing with large type and project entries that arrive via in-view. Work list is the spine. Docs live on a sibling domain.
typography: Confident grotesque, often large and left-aligned. Project titles outweigh descriptions.
palette: Work-driven; historically light or mixed fields rather than permanent #000 shader black.
geometry: Project blocks as full-width scenes with offset images. Not equal cards.
navigation: Short studio nav + work as scroll.
hero: Studio name and a single line of posture. Motion begins as you move, not as a 3D boot.
motion: Lerp'd scroll. In-view classes. Speed-linked parallax on selected nodes only.
interaction: Scroll is the interaction. Hover is secondary.
imagery: Project stills and film crops, revealed on entry.
materials: Paper and image. Smoothness is in the integrator.
spatial_rhythm: Quiet intro, then uneven project scenes.
responsive: Parallax off on touch. Native scroll. Images stack.
signature_motif: In-view + speed-aware parallax with native scrollbar preserved
rejected_defaults: parallax on every layer including body text
transforming a scroll-container so position:fixed breaks
